status: scenario estimates, not measured prices or buyer commitments
business: qualified optical-design blueprints plus separately costed prototype/metrology validation; no fee for generic intelligence
buyer: optical-component or energy-system R&D team needing a specified spectral function
buyer_alternatives: competent conventional thin-film engineer with existing automated tools
purchase_rule: voluntary only when complete verified offering beats all complete alternatives after adoption, uncertainty and delay; scientific novelty supplies no willingness-to-pay multiplier
rights: public-data CC0 and independently implemented classical equations; no patent/exclusivity assumption; third-party legal review unperformed

human_attention_estimate.scenario: hybrid physical qualification case, not observed autonomous operation
human_attention_estimate.safety_or_rights_review_if_indispensable: additional quoted specialist input; not waived by the model
human_attention_estimate.human_comparator: competent conventional workers with real automated thin-film tools; no timed baseline observed; productivity advantage unresolved

price_and_cost_provenance: explicit order-of-magnitude hypotheses; no quotes, market survey or observed procurement calibration
supplier_and_capacity: external coating/metrology capacity must be bought and qualified; no free factory; scenario bottleneck 1–10 accepted deliveries/month; actual capacity and yield unknown
commissioning_capex_if_manufacture_offer: not modeled or available: a fabrication facility requires separate engineering, quotes, commissioning, capex/depreciation, staff, energy, scrap and decommissioning. Software revenue must not be multiplied into manufacturing revenue
financing: capital amounts are hypotheses; parent native-account implementation must explicitly seed each distinct comparison, or use qualified native financing only; no funds secured
scale_verdict: no evidence-bounded USD3B annual profit region established; extrapolating 200 hypothetical buyers or modeled device savings is not profit
actual_resource_measurement: run.py records CPU/wall/peakRSS. Actual host/model billing unknown and not zero by assumption. No incremental purchase or paid model API used.
